disposition_reason: Cacao is not among the sampled crops. The nine crop samples (June 2021, Ponce Enriquez gold-mining area, Azuay) are celery, chives, corn, herbs (coriander), lettuce, turnips, green beans, cassava and carrots; cocoa appears only as an export crop of the canton and in citations of Chavez 2015 / Argüello 2019 on cocoa soil Cd.
disposition_locator: Materials and methods, 'Study area' and 'Sampling collection and analyses' (crop list); Table 2 (crop rows); Introduction (cocoa citations)

study.design: farm survey with probabilistic health risk assessment
study.material_scope: vegetable/field crops and orchard soils; no cocoa material
study.growing_origin_vs_market: Grown in orchards in Camilo Ponce Enriquez canton, Azuay, Ecuador (gold-mining area); not market samples
study.sampling_unit: 9 crop samples (one per crop) and 8 composite soil samples
study.method: Crops: HNO3/H2O2 digestion, ICP-OES (PerkinElmer Optima 5300DV); soils: four-acid digestion, ICP-MS (Cd, Ni, Pb) and ICP-OES
study.lod_loq: Crop LoD mg/kg: As 0.2, Cd 0.004, Cr 0.01, Ni 0.2, Pb 0.1
study.qa: Duplicates and NIST SRM 1573a tomato leaves

contradictions_with_stored_summary: None material to cocoa: the stored summary correctly does not list cocoa among the ingredients; its frontmatter routes to corn, lettuce, carrots, root-vegetables and leafy-greens only.
unresolved: Whether this source should remain routed to the cocoa ingredient page at all: it contains no cocoa occurrence, mitigation or regulatory data. Canton context only (Camilo Ponce Enriquez is also the Azuay sampling canton in romero-estevez2019, Table 1), which could be noted as a geographic overlap but provides no cocoa values.
